== Description ==

[[Mike French]] (mid, glasses, short grey hair, grey zip sweatshirt, hand on his face), [[Nathan Davis]] (mid, navy Mariners jersey, blue Seattle cap, beard), [[Karl Koenig]] (right, red quarter-zip over a yellow tee, short grey-brown hair, arms folded), [[Hayes Hunter]] (right, long brown hair, full grey-brown beard, black jacket, name tag, standing), [[Chris Wirfs]] (mid-left, navy floral/Hawaiian button shirt, glasses pushed up, short dark hair), and [[Greg Shaw]] (far right background, red “MAKE OCTOBER” hoodie, standing) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
